name: howfree
label: How much freedom do Americans have

questions.text: How much freedom do you think Americans have today?  Would you say they have complete freedom, a great deal of freedom, a moderate degree of freedom, not much freedom, or no freedom at all?

name: rhowfree
label: How much freedom Does R have

questions.text: And about you yourself?  Would you say right now that you have complete freedom, a great deal of freedom, a moderate degree of freedom, not much freedom, or no freedom at all?

name: freenow
label: Americans have more freedom than in past

questions.text: Do you think Americans today have more freedom, less freedom, or about the same amount of freedom as in the past?

values.label: about the same amount of freedom

name: rfreenow
label: R have more freedom than in past

questions.text: And how about you? Do you personally feel that you now have more freedom, less freedom, or about the same amount of freedom as you had in the past?

values.label: about the same amount of freedom

name: leftlone
label: Being left alone important for freedom

questions.text:
I'm going to read you several statements about freedom. Each one may say something true and important about freedom, but I'd like to know how important each statement is to you. Is it one of the most important things about freedom, extremely important, very important, somewhat important, or not too important?
A. Freedom is being left alone to do what I want.
questions.stem: I'm going to read you several statements about freedom. Each one may say something true and important about freedom, but I'd like to know how important each statement is to you. Is it one of the most important things about freedom, extremely important, very important, somewhat important, or not too important?
questions.item: A. Freedom is being left alone to do what I want.

name: cntrlife
label: Control R feels over own life

questions.text: Some people feel they have completely free choice and control over the way their lives turn out, and other people feel that what they themselves do has no real effect on what happens to them. Please use this scale to indicate how much freedom of choice and control you feel you have over the way your life turns out.

values.label: a great deal of choice and control
